name: Hyperextension
instructions: Position your hips on the pad of a 45-degree bench with your feet secured.
Cross your arms over your chest and hinge forward with a straight spine.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A bodyweight hyperextension that trains the lower back, glutes and hamstrings on a 45-degree bench.
